title: v4SessionHookMarkets
tagline: Instant Yellow session-paid agent market for Uniswap v4 hooks with Li.Fi: tx proof, off-chain pay
description:
Problem: I want agents to help me build Uniswap hooks, but prepaying agents is risky (what if they commit buggy code, or leave half-way); per-step onchain payouts are slow/expensive. 

My solution: 
- v4SessionHookMarket escrows funds in a Yellow/Nitrolite wallet session and streams instant off-chain milestone payouts on verified (!) progress, with a challenge-window holdback
- Proof = tests + deploy the hook into a real Uniswap v4 pool and show tx IDs
- Final balances settle on-chain when the session ends
I enabled ENS support + Sui + Arc
how_its_made: Next.js UI + Fastify API (SQLite state machine) run work orders and bids with live events. A verifier agent runs Foundry tests and executes Uniswap v4 proof transactions on Base Sepolia, returning TxIDs and logs. Yellow SDK/Nitrolite powers a wallet session: quote rewards + split milestone payouts happen off-chain, then close the session for on-chain settlement. LI.FI widget bridges funds cross-chain for funding/withdraw. + ENS, Sui, Arc
